request: Add industry reference prices and selectable paid maintenance and additional development so selected work can be confirmed at the displayed conditions
title: Add sourced service pricing and selectable paid work agreements
purpose: Let customer choose bounded maintenance and additional development offers with visible prices totals and immutable agreement history

symbols: catalog.pricing: 17 bounded offers and 5 public price sources
order price snapshots and cancellation/correction history
files.purpose: Add a sourced, selectable price menu to the existing contract scope document so fixed-scope maintenance and new work can be recorded at visible agreed prices.
files.previous_behavior: The document distinguished defect correction, paid maintenance and additional work, but had no unit prices, selectable offers, calculated commercial totals or immutable paid-work records.
files.new_behavior: Adds a ninth pricing tab with three monthly plans, ten priced one-off offers and four custom quotation entries. Shows public asking-price examples separately from project proposals, computes monthly period, quantities, one-time costs and 10% VAT, records explicit progress confirmation with a frozen scope/price snapshot, and appends later price/cancellation/correction history. Existing pre-pricing saved states load without losing their journals or invalidating unchanged prior baselines.
files.data_impact: Reads embedded public benchmark and proposal data. Writes optional commerce selection, price overrides, immutable paid-work snapshots and status updates to browser localStorage and portable HTML/JSON. No production DB reads or writes in this change.
files.access_control_impact: none: production permissions and authentication are untouched. Identity and approval references in this local document remain manually entered and do not authenticate either party.
risks: Proposal amounts, working-hour limits and lead times are author-selected defaults and need developer review before customer use.
Public price examples are starting prices under different scopes and contract periods, not industry-average statistics or equivalent platform quotes.
Local agreement records require file sharing and real approval evidence. They do not dispatch work, process payment or establish authenticated electronic signatures.
Monthly work allowances and separately selected jobs need scope review to avoid charging the same included work twice.
files.rollback: Revert the HTML change after exporting any priced agreement history. The previous document preserves unknown commerce data in saved state copies but cannot display the pricing tab; retain the new version and its exports for historical review. Production apps and databases need no rollback.

production_safety.operational_data: No production operational data was read, created, updated or deleted. Functional tests used separate PRICE-QA and LEGACY-QA local documents and localStorage namespaces.
production_safety.schema_migration: none: optional local document commerce state only, with backward-compatible handling of existing journals.
external_side_effects: Read-only browsing of public supplier pricing pages.
Oinzi local-file UI tests and local screenshots; export tests intercepted download clicks.
No vendor or customer messages, purchase requests, payment transactions, production deployments or new server integrations.

verification.evidence: Final pricing and original document JavaScript parses.

verification.command: Embedded catalog and source inventory validation
verification.evidence: Existing 192 features, 21 security items and 56 terms retained; all 272 source hashes match. 17 unique offers have valid source references, integer proposal amounts or explicit custom quotation status, bounded scope and lead-time data.

14 checks passed including 17 offers, four disabled unpriced quotes, mutually exclusive monthly plans, quantity/month persistence, explicit paid acknowledgement, order capture, 1,810,000 KRW supply plus 181,000 VAT calculation, historical price freezing, proposal edit, cancellation-request history, custom quote activation and common journal entries.

verification.command: Oinzi priced HTML/JSON portability and print test
verification.evidence: Seven checks passed: frozen totals and old/new rates retained in HTML, cancellation status retained, JSON checksum/data retained, inconsistent order totals rejected without writes, compatible newer priced histories imported, and print includes pricing and confirmed order.

verification.command: Oinzi legacy document save and upgrade compatibility test
verification.evidence: An actual pre-pricing document saved a decision and baseline at r2. The upgraded document retained the history and current baseline; adding a pricing selection correctly marked the old baseline as having subsequent changes.

verification.command: Oinzi final desktop and 390px mobile visual inspection
verification.evidence: Desktop pricing view reviewed with 28px amounts, 9 tabs and 17 offers. Mobile iframe viewport 388px has document scrollWidth 373px and three vertically stacked 341px plan cards; screenshots reviewed.

residual_risks: Prices are project proposal defaults with VAT excluded and a displayed 10% VAT calculation. They are not user-confirmed final commercial rates or statistical market averages.
Custom AI, recurring payment, migration and professional-security offers remain unpriced until their detailed scope, amount and lead time are entered.
Local histories, manual confirmations and exports require the parties to maintain versioned shared files and actual approval evidence.
